pr_title: log-backup: add progress bar for truncate
pr_body: ### What problem does this PR solve? Issue Number: close #36914 Problem Summary: `br log truncate` may keep for a long time, however for now there isn't anything indices the progress. ### What is changed and how it works? Added a progress bar using `mpb`. Also a new interface in the `ConsoleOps` have been added. ### Check List Tests - [ ] Unit test - [ ] Integration test - [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below) This script can generate the progress bar in last segment. ```go package main import ( "time" "github.com/pingcap/tidb/br/pkg/glue" ) func main() { g := glue.ConsoleOperations{glue.StdIOGlue{}} total := 10000 pb := g.StartProgressBar("Test", total, glue.WithTimeCost(), glue.WithConstExtraField("hello", "world")) for i := 0; i < total; i++ { pb.Inc() time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond) } pb.Wait() } ``` - [ ] No code ### Release note Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note. ```release-note `br log truncate` now have a progress bar. ```

review_comments: can we wait all worker finish apply here if p.Inc() not trigger?
If the total count is `0`, the progress would finish as soon as it being created.
Does package `mpb` support to close the second progress bar `pw` earlier than `p`?
pw would always be open after `p` closed. 🤔
(Note that `mpb` would stop refreshing once it has been fulfilled.)
we may need to keep it.
I think perhaps we actually need to add some unit tests for `truncate`... 🥲
